items.title: AI Doomsaying Is an Aggressive Sales Pitch
items.summary: When AI insiders warn that their products could wipe out humanity, they mean that their own work is maximally important and demands unprecedented investment. This extinction fantasy distracts from the real damage AI is already doing.
